title: Aliment
summary: AL'IMENT, noun [Latin alimentum, from alo, to feed.] That which nourishes; food; nutriment; any thing which feeds or adds to a substance, animal or vegetable, in natural growth.

inlines.v: AL'IMENT, noun [Latin alimentum, from alo, to feed.] That which nourishes; food; nutriment; any thing which feeds or adds to a substance, animal or vegetable, in natural growth.
